changes: Cartridge changes now form one physical sequence: the LCD fades to its neutral substrate, console power lights turn off, the new cart inserts, and power returns for BIOS startup.
Opening a drawer during startup now queues its pause for the first safe BIOS frame, eliminating white or stale frames without locking menus or console switching.
Library detail cards now show battery-save availability and data status plus a clear three-slot save-state occupancy indicator.
Portrait sticky layers and tabletop controls no longer clip, overlap, or allow scrolled library content to bleed through.
Segmented choices, App Behaviour, App Data, expandable explanations, badges, and save indicators now animate within the existing GAMEBOY LAB style.
LCD zoom, bezel layering, cartridge motion, timer cleanup, and transition ownership received a full flicker and race-condition audit.
